paper_title: Searching for Scalar Dark Matter via Coupling to Fundamental Constants with Photonic, Atomic and Mechanical Oscillators
notes: Paper constrains two independent coupling combinations via coefficient separation technique: d_e and |d_me - d_g|. Most sensitive limits are d_e ≳ 1.59 × 10^-1 and |d_me - d_g| ≳ 6.97 × 10^-1 across mass band 4.4 × 10^-19 ≲ m_φ ≲ 6.8 × 10^-14 eV. These are mass-independent (flat) bounds valid over the stated range, encoded as two-point horizontal lines. The experiment uses clock comparisons between Cryogenic Sapphire Oscillator (CSO), Hydrogen Maser (HM), and bulk acoustic wave quartz oscillator (OCXO) to search for frequency modulations induced by scalar dark matter coupling to fundamental constants. Data from 16 days HM-OCXO and 2 days CSO-OCXO comparison. No DM signal detected; limits derived via power bin search and Monte Carlo simulations at 95% confidence. Local DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm³ assumed per Ref. [39].
